game_name: Call of Duty®: Black Ops III

verdict.tagline: Endless custom maps and mods elevate a flawed classic.
for_you_if: you want to play custom zombie maps
you plan to play offline or locally
not_for_you_if: you need stable official online servers
you want to avoid security exploits

claims.claim: Reviewers report security and hacking vulnerabilities in online play, leading to recommendations to use third-party patches or client software like T7patch or the boi client.

citations.review_text:
zombies is great on this game

i just hate how it's full of hacks now :<
Worth the money if you enjoy custom zombie maps. Just make sure you download the anti hack software.
please buy at risk , download the boi client so you wont get hacked while played .
the king of all CODs. If i had to pick a COD to play for the rest of my life it would be bo3. Custom zombies is fun and Multiplayer is still fun. PLAY USING T7X.
If your game requires a 3rd party patch to run without the risk of your PC becoming vulnerable to hacks It should come with a big warning or be delisted. Completely unacceptable. Full stop.

I love zombies in this game, but I cannot recommend it due to its rampant security issues that will never be addressed by Activision. This isn't a "haha get banned" issue, this is a "people can install and run stuff on your rig and you have no idea + grab your IP address" issue. Activison is selling an unsafe product to customers for full price without a disclaimer stating that the game is unsafe to play online.

This makes a part of the package, Multiplayer, completely unplayable. If you bought this game for the multiplayer, then you got sold a product that is not safe to play. If you are an average joe who wants to relive the old CoD games on PC and naturally does not know about T7patch, you are in danger of having malware installed on your computer, or worse, having your personal information stolen by bad actors.

If you want to play this game, download T7patch and run it before you boot Black Ops 3 every single time. This should not be a requirement.

cohorts.label: 100h+
cohorts.summary: Longtime players enjoy workshop mods and custom maps while struggling with confusing campaigns, spawn camping, and severe security exploits.

claims.claim: Reviewers report that the game suffers from remote code execution (RCE) security exploits and hacking vulnerabilities on official servers, requiring community-made patches or third-party tools to play safely.

citations.review_text:
Let me start of by saying I absolutely LOVE THIS GAME, it is a childhood staple for me, and these flaws do not take away from that fact, it just is unfortunate.

RCE exploits heightened by the February "security update"

Multiple RCE exploits still exist in the game, allowing malicious actors to remotely execute code on your system when connected to servers. 

I don't believe this will ever be fixed, so I can't recommend the game currently, unless you're using community patches to fix the security issues. Private matches are not inherently safe and "friends only" doesnt guarantee only trusted people connect.

Be safe. Im intentionally not going into detail, to avoid spreading knowledge of the exploits, especially since I assume this will never officially be fixed.

Recommend only for Zombies and Custom Zombies. Use only with T7 Patch, or the BO3 Reforged workshop mod (to disconnect you from the Demonware servers). Other than that, this is basically Activision-approved malware.

Zombies. Workshop. Not much more to say.
make sure to buy the full version of the game with all the zombies dlcs, deselect the campaign and multiplayer when downloading.
DOWNLOAD THE T7 PATCH and/or the black ops 3 game launcher as to avoid hackers as activison have left the servers in a very unsafe state.

Abandonware, servers are a risk to your computer safety.
Its crazy that being simply logged on Tryarch server can be a risk...
And more unreal then that is that you can name 3 or 4 buggs for each Zmap that completly void you of clearing the EE and you are forced to reset.
For the price this game goes 59,99€ or 99,99€ Deluxe  for all Zmaps + extras(required for achievements) its purely not worth, even on discount this game is Extremely expensive for the little it offers in terms of quality of service you are paying to get RCExd or deal with lots of hours lost because the EE step you worked on did not spawned the corrusponding item or it went behind a unreachable part of the map.

If you are thinking on buying this is a better investment to use 59€ or the 99€ to buy one or multiple of the following games

Review by a friend playing through Steam Family:

I played this game through the steam library and yet I still feel like I should get a refund, if bugs in this game were named, they would be locusts, they swarm and eat away at your very nerve. Every single bit of this game is fighting you, the zombies, the RNG, the demented Easter Eggs, every single stray atom of geometry that has the gravitational pull of Jupiter, a perfect storm of ♥♥♥♥ designed to consume your time and nerves.
I love this game but it has been abandoned and has RCE vulnerabilities. Scroptss' T7Patch fixes these, but no game should require a patch of that sort. RIP Alyssa.

claims.claim: Reviewers note that custom maps and mods are supported through the Steam Workshop, adding substantial replayability.

citations.review_text:
The custom zombies community is still alive and well in 2026. 

Downloading community made mods and maps is straightforward thanks to the Steam Workshop; adding countless hours of replayability even 10 years after it's release date.

Highly recommend, only complaint is the four player Easter egg requirement with some Easter eggs, but other than that, this game has a very nice zombies mode and the steam workshop adds even more content to find and play.

Oh boy, what is there to say about BO3, it probably the first sign of the end for me for COD, younger me used the excuse of Ghost & AW's bad to okay stories as them being due not being sequels to the good CODs, but then "Train go boom" and here we are on BO7 somehow... 
...Anyway while the campaign was terrible, the multiplayer was actually kinda fun (for me at least), the movement and Character Ultimates was a refreshing change of pace from basic area combat loop that ever previous call of duty was doing (at least before almost every single multiplayer game also decided it was doing ultimates), and the exo movement didn't feel as stiff as AW, but of course, it's a Post-Dev COD game so you better use a third party service if you don't want to get screwed trying to play any online stuff.
Alright, but who gives a damn about all that, everyone is there for the same thing, the Zombies! It's Peak, this game has some of the best maps in the whole zombies franchise and what it doesn't have with the base game and Zombies Chronicles, the steam workshop will mostly likely have it, along with sh*tpost maps, rage maps, highly detailed gems, and maps that can even compete with the standard maps. If you played any COD zombies in the past and liked it a little, you will love this game, even despite the Cod Point slop.
It's a solid 9 out of 10, but if the zombies wasn't counted... it's a 3.7/10, so yeah... buy it on a good sale (like at least 50%) and kill some Zombies!
